homepage.title: Designed with intention. Made with individuality. Created to be personal.
homepage.description:
Jewelry beyond the expected.

A celebration of organic forms, beautiful imperfections, and individual expression. Each piece reimagines traditional silhouettes through sculptural shapes, unexpected details, and colorful natural gemstones.

Designed with intention, crafted by hand in NYC, and made exclusively with recycled precious metals and natural gemstones.
homepage.heroAlt: Malayan garnet set in a sculptural Argentium silver ring.

about:
With over a decade of experience in New York City's jewelry industry, I bring together my background as a visual artist and a management professional with a passion for jewelry design, craftsmanship, and creative expression.

As a woman, immigrant and independent designer, creating my own jewelry brand represents more than a business venture. It is an expression of my personal journey, creative independence, and desire to build something meaningful and uniquely my own.

My design philosophy is inspired by the beauty of organic forms, irregular shapes, and the unexpected. I am drawn to unconventional silhouettes, sculptural elements, and fluid lines that challenge traditional jewelry aesthetics. I believe there is beauty in imperfection and that jewelry should be expressive, distinctive, and individual.

My vision is to create jewelry that goes beyond traditional adornment. Each design is an opportunity to tell a story, celebrate individuality, and create a personal connection with the person wearing it. I also embrace personalization, offering designs that feel meaningful and reflect each individual's character and style.

Natural, colorful gemstones are an essential part of my creative language. They introduce unexpected touches of color, contrast, and personality, bringing each piece to life and highlighting its unique character.

Every piece is made to order and handcrafted in New York City, allowing for a thoughtful and intentional approach to design and production. I work exclusively with recycled silver and gold and natural gemstones, placing sustainability, quality, and craftsmanship at the center of my practice.

Ultimately, my brand is a reflection of who I am: a woman, an immigrant, an artist, and an independent designer. It celebrates individuality, embraces imperfection, and reimagines jewelry as a form of personal expression.

Designed with intention. Made with individuality. Created to be personal.

jewelry.title: Solaris Necklace
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the radiance of the sun and the beauty of fluid movement, the Solaris Necklace features an organic, irregular sunburst silhouette with delicate, wave-like details that capture a sense of movement and natural elegance.

At its center sits a 5 mm natural round gemstone, available in Iolite, Blue Topaz, or Amethyst.

Crafted in Argentium silver or 14kt yellow gold and available with a 16" or 18" chain, this pendant celebrates fluidity, individuality, and the beauty of organic forms.

A delicate yet distinctive piece that brings effortless elegance to everyday wear.

jewelry.title: Solaris  Ring
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the radiance of the sun and the beauty of fluid movement, the Solaris  Ring features an organic, irregular sunburst silhouette with delicate, wave-like details that create a sense of movement around a brilliant center gemstone.

At its center sits a 5 mm natural round gemstone, available in Iolite, Blue Topaz, or Amethyst.

Crafted in Argentium silver or 14kt yellow gold, the ring features a subtly textured, slightly rough finish rather than a completely smooth surface, enhancing its natural, handcrafted character.

A delicate yet distinctive piece that celebrates fluidity, movement, and the beauty of imperfection, perfectly complementing the Solaris Flow Pendant.

jewelry.title: Liquida Ring
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the beauty of molten metal and fluid movement, the Liquida Ring features an organic, free-flowing design with irregular curves that embrace the natural beauty of each gemstone.

A one-of-a-kind, made-to-order statement ring, featuring a natural 8 × 6 mm gemstone, available in London Blue Topaz, Amethyst, Blue Sapphire, Garnet, or Peridot.

Crafted in your choice of Argentium silver or 14kt yellow gold, its smooth, polished finish and sculptural details create a bold yet timeless piece.

A celebration of individuality, fluidity, and effortless elegance, each ring is uniquely made to capture the beauty of liquid forms frozen in time.

jewelry.title: Fiamma Necklace
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the graceful movement of dancing flames and the beauty of natural forms, the Fiamma Pendant features an organic, free-flowing silhouette with soft, irregular curves that capture a sense of fluidity and effortless elegance.

Crafted in Argentium silver or 14kt yellow gold, its smooth, polished surface and sculptural shape reflect the energy and movement of fire, creating a distinctive statement piece that feels both modern and timeless.

Available with your choice of a 15", 16", or 18" chain, this pendant celebrates individuality, natural beauty, and the elegance of organic forms.

jewelry.title: Fiamma Earrings
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the organic shapes of dancing flames, the Fiamma Earrings feature a bold, free-flowing silhouette with soft, irregular curves that capture a sense of fluidity and effortless elegance.

Crafted in Argentium silver or 14kt gold, these sculptural earrings are available with 6 mm round natural Garnet or Amethyst gemstones, or in a plain silver version for a minimalist look.

A distinctive statement piece that celebrates individuality, movement, and the beauty of organic forms.

jewelry.title: Unda Ring
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the fluid movement of water, the Unda Ring features an organic, free-flowing silhouette with soft, irregular curves and gentle waves that capture the essence of fluidity, creating a sense of movement and effortless elegance.

Crafted in Argentium silver or 14kt yellow gold, its smooth, polished finish and sculptural shape create a minimalist yet distinctive design.

A celebration of simplicity, individuality, and effortless elegance, this timeless ring is perfect for wearing alone as a subtle yet sophisticated statement.

jewelry.title: Unda Trio Stacking Rings
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the fluid movement of water, the Unda Trio Stacking Rings features an organic, free-flowing silhouette with soft, irregular curves and gentle waves that capture the essence of fluidity, creating a sense of movement and effortless elegance.

This three-ring set includes two Argentium silver rings with 14kt yellow gold settings and one 14kt yellow gold ring,  all three rings beautifully accented with sparkling lab-grown diamonds.

Designed to be worn together, each ring brings its own unique character, creating a harmonious balance of contrasting metals, sculptural curves, and subtle brilliance.

A modern yet timeless set that celebrates fluidity, individuality, and the beauty of organic forms.

jewelry.title: Tempora Necklace
jewelry.description:
Past, Present & Future

Inspired by the continuous flow of time, the Tempora Necklace features an elegant, organic design with three delicately arranged gemstones that symbolize the past, present, and future, capturing the beauty of life's ever-changing journey.

At its center, three 4 mm round gemstones are arranged vertically, available in Multicolored Spinels, Black Spinels, or Opals, each offering a unique expression of individuality and timeless elegance.

Crafted in Argentium silver or 14kt yellow gold and available with a 16" or 18" chain, this delicate necklace celebrates the memories we cherish, the moments we live, and the possibilities that lie ahead.

A meaningful yet timeless piece that reflects the beauty of transformation, connection, and the natural flow of life.

Each 4 mm round  natural gemstone is set in a sleek, minimalist setting, available in three variations: Tricolor Spinel, Black Spinel, or Opal.

Crafted in Argentium silver or 14kt gold, with your choice of a 16" or 18" chain.

A timeless piece that brings together meaningful symbolism and effortless elegance.

jewelry.title: Unica Signet Ring
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the beauty of individuality and personal expression, the Unica Signet Ring features a classic oval silhouette with soft, sculptural details that combine simplicity with timeless elegance.

Personalized with your chosen initial, the ring features a subtly textured surface accented by a delicate diamond, creating a beautiful balance between organic details and a refined, polished finish.

Crafted in Argentium silver or 14kt yellow gold, each ring is made to order, celebrating individuality, meaningful connections, and the beauty of something uniquely yours.

A modern yet timeless piece that reflects the collection's celebration of natural beauty, individuality, and personal expression, designed to carry your story wherever life takes you.
